trap.label: can’t / must have / might
trap.wrong: It can’t be the battery, it must have being the cable.
trap.right: It can't be the battery; it must have been the cable.
trap.why: Em português “deve ter sido” leva particípio; o brasileiro confunde being e been. Em inglês, modal + have + been.

mcq.q: Which is correct? (can’t / must have / might)
opts: It might have been the plug.

fix.wrong: It must have being the cable.
fix.right: It must have been the cable.

fix.wrong: It can’t has been the battery.
fix.right: It can't have been the battery.

fix.wrong: It might to be the plug.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva (quase certo, passado): “It was the cable.”
rewrite.answer: It must have been the cable.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva (possível, presente): “Perhaps it is the plug.”
Reescreva (impossível, presente): “It is not possible that it is the battery.”
